name: Wheels
description: Factory ZL1 1LE: forged aluminum 19x11 front / 19x12 rear (OE offsets ≈ ET11 / ET41). ZL1: 20x10 / 20x11 forged. Race: lightweight forged 18 or 19 in wheels sized for slicks; the brake package decides the minimum diameter (390 mm ZL1 rotors/6-pots need 19 in; Essex 372 mm kits fit 18 in ATS-V-size wheels).

components.name: Front wheel
components.description: Front wheel; width and offset define track, scrub radius and caliper clearance. Stay close to the OE ET11 19x11 geometry unless suspension geometry is re-engineered.

factory.name: GM ZL1 1LE forged aluminum 19x11 front
factory.notes: OE offset ≈ ET11 (wheel-size lists 9–13 mm; Apex fitment ET11). ZL1: 20x10 forged, OE ET ≈ 20 (18–22 mm). SS 1LE: 20 in forged with 285/30R20.

raceOptions.name: Apex VS-5RS / SM-10RS / ARC-8 19x11 ET9–ET11 (front)
raceOptions.notes: Direct ZL1 1LE fitment; 1LE owners run ~-3.2° front camber.

raceOptions.name: Apex 19x11 ET36 (SS 1LE with AP 372 mm kit)
Forgeline GS1R / GA3R, BBS FI-R / E88, Forgestar F14, Rays/Volk TE37 (18–19 in, 5x120)
raceOptions.notes: Spec offset/backspace to clear the chosen caliper; ask for a caliper template check.

hardware.torqueSequence: Star pattern, 2 passes; re-check after first session

installNotes: Check caliper-to-spoke clearance (≥ 3 mm) and caliper-to-barrel radial clearance with a template before buying wheels.
Clean hub face and wheel mounting pad; no paint/corrosion in the clamp area.
inspection: Inspect for cracks at spokes/lug seats after curb strikes; check runout when mounting tires.

components.name: Hub-centric rings
components.description: Rings that fill the gap between a larger aftermarket center bore and the 66.9 mm hub pilot so the wheel is centered by the hub, not only by the nut cones.

raceOptions.name: Aluminum hub rings 66.9 mm ID x wheel bore OD
raceOptions.notes: Aluminum, not plastic, near hot brakes.

installNotes: Push into wheel bore before mounting.

components.name: Center caps
components.description: Cosmetic caps; usually removed on a race car for quick inspection of axle nuts and to save weight (or secured so they cannot fly off).

modelRef.dimensions: ~64 mm snap-in cap in the 66.9 mm bore, flush with the lug face

components.name: Valve stems
components.description: Factory: aluminum clamp-in stems that are part of the TPMS sensor. Race: short metal clamp-in stems with metal caps (rubber snap-ins can fail at track speed).

raceOptions.name: Metal clamp-in high-speed valve stems with metal caps

inspection: Check caps fitted and no leaks.

modelRef.dimensions: TPMS clamp-in aluminium stem, ~40 mm, through the drop well between two spoke pairs
modelRef.features: Aluminium stem, hex clamp nut, black cap

components.name: Wheel balance weights
components.description: Adhesive weights on the inner barrel. Race balancers often use extra-strength adhesive plus tape, as heat from big brakes softens adhesive.
installNotes: Clean barrel with solvent before applying; keep clear of caliper sweep.
inspection: Check weights present after each session (vibration = lost weight).
